ADAS.description: All Advanced Driver Assist Systems data.

DistanceToObject.description: Longitudinal distance to the nearest detected obstacle. 999 when no obstacle is detected.

TimeToCollision.description: Time to collision with the nearest obstacle at current closing speed. 999 when not closing.

ObjectCount.description: Number of obstacles detected in the current frame.

InferenceLatency.description: Wall-clock latency of the perception network for the current frame.
